notes.subject: go bala setšhaba
notes.rationale: Palo ya banna ba Yisraele — go bala hlogo ya setšhaba, taba ya palo ka moka

notes.subject: botshelo
notes.rationale: נפשו ke 'moya wa gagwe / botshelo bja gagwe' — se sa Sepedi 'botshelo' se bitša sebopego, e sego 'moya' ka mo go tlwaelegilego

notes.subject: hlogo
notes.rationale: נשא ראש 'go tšea hlogo' — go bolela go bala batho ka palo; se sengwe le se sengwe sa 'hlogo' se lalediwa go dula se le gona bjalo ka seswantšho

notes.subject: בפקד ... בפקד
notes.rationale: פקד di boela di bapalelwa gatee-gatee-tee — go bolelwa gate le gate gate ge go bala; phetolelo e bolotše go boela ga lentsu

translation: Ge o tšea ⟨את⟩ hlogo ya bana ba Yisraele ka go ba bala ka palo, gomme ba tla fa, motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe sekollo sa botshelo bja gagwe go Yahwe ge ba bala ⟨את⟩ bona; gomme go se ke ga ba le mokgobo go bona ge ba bala ⟨את⟩ bona.
